An '''alien cardplayer''' once played [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] with four other players, including [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], in the [[Flip of the Credit]] [[Casino/Legends|casino]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]]. In one hand the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] player folded in light of Calrissian's bold play, not realizing Calrissian was bluffing.
